definition: Hypothetical unchanged nominal deposit. Native jeonse model prices within complete normally supported complex-area cohorts at both endpoints; current measured household weights

states.confirmed: Budget-side group meets 100 households, 10 complexes, maximum complex share 20%
states.none_in_modeled_cohort: Zero within the analyzed normally supported cohort, not zero market listings
states.small_subset: Budget-side group below publication size/concentration criteria; unresolved
states.insufficient_source: Parent regional paired cohort below support/coverage criteria; unresolved

limits: Not actual listings, household moves, deposit safety or guaranteed contractability
Current stock weights are not historical inventory; unknown area inventory outside denominator
Missing/small groups are not failures; retention counts include unresolved states
Price envelopes are uncalibrated model sensitivity, not confidence bounds
Different area groups have different housing/support populations; smaller area need not have more confirmed regions
precision: Shares/envelope endpoints: whole percent, independently rounded; mean prices: 0.1 KRW hundred-million. Region counts are geographic classification counts, not household counts
